scope: Fresh worker processes, alternating prepared/unprepared arms. Same sealed settings, one real calibrated capture, two inspection calls per session. Preparation consumes no image and runs no network forward. First-image times include packet IO, inference, ICP/fit, requested graphics and cleanup; exclude acquisition/file decoding, GUI, robot and hardware acceptance. Preparation shifts startup; it does not remove it.
